panels.description:
In this dashboard, the total disk, used, available, and usage values are kept consistent with the Size, Used, Avail, and Use% columns of the df command, and the Use% value is rounded to one decimal place for greater accuracy.

Note: the Use% algorithm in df is: (size - free) * 100 / (avail + (size - free)); if the result divides evenly it is that value, otherwise it is that value + 1, and the unit of the result is %.

panels.title: Disk Read/Write Rate (IOPS)

panels.description:
Time spent on I/O within each second of wall-clock time. (wall-clock time)

node_disk_io_time_seconds_total:
Seconds the disk spent on input/output operations. This is a cumulative value. (Milliseconds Spent Doing I/Os)

rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[1m]):
Computes the per-second rate: (last value - previous value) / timestamp difference, i.e. the proportion of time the disk spent on I/O operations within one second.
